result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in every promotion listing and in the lookup by code. The full suite passes offline (608 tests).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(500)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. Nothing else constructed the record outside the store and service.
- **`PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category means all products. The existing 5-argument method stays and delegates with no description, so current callers are unchanged.
- **`PromotionStore.java`**: the shared select and the insert include the column. Every listing and `findByCode` already went through the shared select, so they all return it.
- **`Rows.java`**: the row mapper reads `description`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new test `keepsDescriptionOfPromotionInEveryListing`. It covers the active-on-date, active-in-region, category, unused, best-for-category and by-code lookups, plus a promotion without a description.

I did not change the demo scenario, so the demo promotions still have no description. I did not commit.
